children: NorthWestern Energy Group affirmed its 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance of $3.68 to $3.83 per diluted share ahead of its investor conference.
Executives will present company information to current and potential investors at the EEI Financial Conference on November 8–10.
The company reiterated long-term EPS and rate base growth targets of 4% to 6% from their respective 2024 bases.
A $3.2 billion five-year capital plan is expected to support generation investment and annualized earnings and rate base growth of about 4% to 6%.
NorthWestern Energy Group said final approval of its pending Black Hills merger remained outstanding, with a Montana order expected by November 12.
